title.narrative: Apoyo a la Transicin Competitiva Agroalimentaria
Supporting Food and Agricultural Sector Competitiveness

description.narrative: The project aims to enhance the efficiency of Dominican agriculture in order to make the agri-food sector more competitive and reduce poverty in rural areas. It intends to eliminate important trade inefficiencies in the sector, improve the efficiency of public sector expenditures, reassigning resources to public goods and services. It includes investments in technology support, agro-food safety and innoculations, and institutional reform.
